title: Collect the odd numbers
description: Write a function `odds_up_to(n)` that returns a list of every odd number from 0 to `n`, inclusive.
hints: Function to consider: range(), starting from 1 with a step of 2
Starting the range at 1 instead of 0 shifts every value produced by stepping 2 from even to odd.
expected_behavior: Returns every odd number from 0 to n inclusive, ascending.
explanation: Only the starting point changes from evens_up_to - the same step-by-2 idea, offset by one so it lands on odd numbers instead.
